diffDescription: Static example · no files will be changed
historyDescription: 500 fixed-height samples. Only the visible range and its buffer are kept in the DOM.
historyLabel: Virtualized history. Use arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home or End to scroll.
sampleQuestion: How does this spike keep a conversation with 500 messages lightweight?
sampleAnswer: Only messages near the visible area are rendered. Scroll the history to browse all 500 local samples.
composerPlaceholder: Write a message to the C# host…
composerHint: Ctrl+Enter sends · Enter adds a line · no AI
previewDetail: Browser preview: the C# bridge is unavailable. Sending is disabled; no connection has been simulated.
connectingDetail: Waiting for a real response from the C# host.
connectedDetail: The C# host responded. Sending only echoes your text, without using AI.
failedDetail: The bridge could not be validated. Reconnect or reopen the tool window.
echoReceived: Echo received from the C# host.
externalLinkBlocked: External links are not opened in this spike.
error_invalid_message: The host rejected the message: invalid format.
error_invalid_response: Bridge response rejected: invalid format or correlation.
error_timeout: The host did not respond within 8 seconds. Your text was preserved.
error_bridge_unavailable: The C# bridge is unavailable. Reopen the tool window to try again.
error_bridge_busy: Wait for the previous message to finish.
error_payload_too_large: The message exceeds the host's size limit.
error_unknown_type: The host did not recognize the message type.
error_unsupported_version: The host did not recognize the message version.
error_unknown: The host reported an error. Your text was preserved.
